site_name: Sparrow Farm Infant And Nusery School
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (026-PE-BB-ZZ-DR-A-0901 Rev P01, 026-PE-BB-00-DR-A-0010 Rev P01, 026-PE-BA-ZZ-DR-A-0801 Rev P01, 026-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0008 Rev P01, 026-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0006 Rev P01, 026-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-001 Rev A (received 24/07/2013)
026-PE-BB-ZZ-DR-A-0802 Rev P02, 026-PE-BB-03-DR-A-0301 Rev P01, 026-PE-XX-GF-DR-A-1304 Rev P01, 026-PE-XX-GF-DR-A-1305 Rev P01 (received 03/09/2013)
026-PE-BA-00-DR-A-0007 Rev P02 (received 06/09/2013)
026-PE-00-99-DR-ME-0080 Rev P02 (received 10/09/2013)
026-PE-00-99-DR-A-9904 Rev P02 (received 16/09/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The external surfaces of the extensiond and building hereby approved shall be constructed from the materials specified in the application.

Condition : 4 - The building shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These works shall then be carried out within three months of the occupation of the development.  These details shall include means of enclosure; hard surfacing material and minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc). Soft landscape works shall include planting plans;  schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and an implementation programme.
Condition : 5 - The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved

Condition : 6 - The electic car charging point shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The electric car charging point shall then be maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.

Condition : 7 - The cycle parking shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The cycle parking shall then be maintained in this form for as long as the development remains in existence.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.
description: Erection of a single storey nursery and early years building, a single storey front extension and a single storey rear infill extension
